name: Long-Term Residence (via Renewed Visa de Séjour)

requirements.blocker_text: Continuous renewal of the visa de séjour (typically the 3-month multiple-entry category) without an established maximum, since no distinct intermediate permanent-residence status was found.

evidence_required.document: History of continuous visa de séjour renewals

outcome.duration_length: indefinite in practice through repeated renewal; no fixed 'permanent residence' certificate confirmed to exist

sources.title: Embassy of Chad in Paris (official Chadian diplomatic mission) -- visa information sheet: only 1-month and 3-month visa de séjour terms are described, both explicitly renewable, with no separate long-term or permanent residence instrument mentioned

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Chad). STATUS: DRAFT -- STRUCTURAL FINDING, disclosed rather than invented: no distinct permanent-residence status (comparable to Botswana's Five-Year Residency or Jordan's Five-Year Residency) was found for Chad in this pass. The only documented residence mechanism is the renewable 1-month/3-month visa de séjour, apparently renewed indefinitely by those who remain, with naturalisation (at 15 years' residence, see td_citizenship_naturalisation.json) as the only confirmed FIXED status upgrade. This file models that reality rather than fabricating an intermediate PR tier with invented thresholds -- consistent with this dataset's convention of disclosing genuine absences (see Vietnam's narrow permanent_residence.json and Vietnam's international_protection.json for the same honesty pattern applied to different countries). If Chad does maintain a distinct 'carte de résident' or long-term residence certificate, it was not found via any source reached in this pass, including a blocked Ministry of Interior/DGSN search.
